response.text:
I can’t determine a document’s exact conclusion or its confidence interval from the filename alone. I don’t have access to the file contents, and I won’t invent text or numbers.

If you want the exact conclusion and the confidence interval, please either:
- Upload forecast-final.pdf here, or
- Paste the document’s conclusion/results text, or
- Give a direct link I can access.

After you provide the file or text I will:
- Quote the exact conclusion verbatim,
- Extract any reported confidence intervals (e.g., 95% CI) and give the page/section where they appear,
- Note any uncertainty if the CI is implied, presented in a figure, or requires numeric extraction from a table or chart.
